rv.q: Tambo & Bones is a stirring piece of work by American poet and playwright Dave Harris which wraps its confrontation in exquisite humour and layers of metatheatricality.
This show defies convention – it is extraordinary and offers a unique theatrical experience that this reviewer guarantees will live long in the memory.
Unflinching, blisteringly intelligent, and wickedly funny, it draws the audience into its grasp only to ask—when does watching become complicity?

cn.t: Dave Harris's metatheatrical work earns acclaim for its stirring confrontation of difficult themes wrapped in exquisite humor, with Matthew Xia's direction delivering an extraordinary and thought-provoking theatrical experience.
